answer: Attestation edges transmit trust through bounded-length random walks, so influence depends on path probability rather than unboundedly multiplying across identities. A Sybil trellis of mutually controlled accounts may sit like a lagoon behind a sparse external cut; its low conductance limits connections to honest nodes. With capped per-identity weight and min-cut transitivity bounds, the cluster’s aggregate voting weight is correspondingly bounded, even as new identities appear at dawn.
